thread:
liam: Published RCA for the Dedicated burst/config mismatch issue. Doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/postmortems/2148801111-dedicated-burst-config-mismatch

Quick summary: misinterpretation between two config formats ('max_share' allowed as absolute GPU count for older pools vs fractional for new pools). The autoscaler accepted both formats but normalized only one path, which led to a small set of Dedicated pools being temporarily over-allocated -> eviction pressure on best-effort jobs and increased tail latency for some Dedicated routes from 03:07 to 03:29 UTC. No data exfiltration. Customers saw intermittent degraded throughput and retries.

ops-bot: Incident INC-214880 (https://incidents.redwood/INC-214880) created and resolved. Follow-ups added to the incident backlog.

carmen: I'll take the config parsing fix. Root cause: dual-path parsing (legacy string config vs new float). Working on a single validation layer + schema migration. ETA: patch + unit tests by EOD.

code excerpt showing the bug:
```
# legacy path parsed '0.3' as string -> kept, new path expects float -> defaults to 0.0
if isinstance(cfg.max_share, str):
    max_share = cfg.max_share  # left as '0.3' (bug)
else:
    max_share = float(cfg.max_share)
# should coerce and validate both paths
max_share = float(cfg.max_share)
if not (0 < max_share <= 1):
    raise ConfigError('max_share must be a fraction between 0 and 1')
```

dina: I'll own customer comms and the postmortem summary we send to affected accounts. Drafting a short note to explain impact & mitigations. Want to coordinate with legal for wording re: SLAs.

rafa: I'll add telemetry alarms for config-parsing anomalies and a dashboard for pool allocation vs expected. Also will add a detection rule for sudden deviation between configured max_share and effective allocation.

pran: I'll run the migration plan and add an integration test that simulates mixed-format configs. Also will create a canary job that applies the migration to a single pool for 1h, validate allocations, then roll out.

liam: Owners & checkpoints: carmen -> patch + tests (by EOD). pran -> migration canary + integration tests (canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC). rafa -> telemetry and alerts (48h). dina -> customer comms (draft in 4h). 14-day follow-up: audit all Dedicated pool configs and run a migration sweep. 90-day: add policy to prevent dual-format acceptance and include schema enforcement in CI.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: PR opened carmen -> https://git.internal.redwood/pulls/9912 (config: normalize max_share parsing).

carmen: PR posted, requesting reviews from eng-runtime and eng-qa. Adding backwards-compat tests.

dina: I'll post the customer note draft to the doc and tag legal.

pran: Scheduling canary in staging now; plan to promote to a single low-traffic Dedicated pool in prod if green. Will post results here.

rafa: Created dashboard and alert; linking to postmortem. Alert threshold: |configured_share - effective_share| > 0.15 for >5m.

liam: Thanks team. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for owners, test results, and the final external note. If you can't make the sync at 15:30 UTC, react with :raised_hand: or DM me.
